editorial.blurb: Galata brings authentic Turkish and Mediterranean cuisine to Lakeview with exceptional hospitality and consistently outstanding dishes that keep diners returning.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the lamb shish and manti as your main courses—reviewers call them absolute standouts—and don't miss the kunafah for dessert, a unique finale that sets this place apart.
